description.value:
Over the eons, master artisans have used imperfect copies of the Artifex Telluria to craft all manner of earthen wonders. The true Artifex Telluria is a legend even among xiomorns, a tool of peerless quality supposedly used by Sairazul herself to shape the first of her children from living rock. This storied artifact is believed to be one of the few implements capable of employing the equally legendary Tectonic Forge to craft a vessel worthy of housing the spirit of a vault builder.

When the artifex is used to create or repair constructs, structures, or other objects composed mostly or entirely of stone, crystal, or other earthen materials, it reduces overall crafting time by half and grants a +2 item bonus to Crafting checks.

Activate—Earthwright (concentrate, manipulate)

Effect Over the course of 1 minute, you sculpt up to a @Template[cube|distance:10] of earth or stone into a new form, with the effects of shape stone.
